judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Exclamations and 'Off to that barrow with you!' imitate Nox well, but the offer is over-built (a stolen item plus a missing hired man plus a hook to another quest giver), and 'My worst fears... have come to pass' / 'no time for weeping' is a more measured, literary register than Westwood's quick, jokey quest givers.
